title: Marital compatibility and its relationship to marital variables: a sociological study on married Libyan women in Tripoli
core_idea: Identify the dimensions of marital adjustment among married Libyan women in Tripoli and examine whether marital adjustment varies by type of family, type of marriage, spousal age difference, duration of marriage, and criteria used to select a spouse, based on a survey of women in the Andalus neighborhood.
tldr: A survey-based sociological study aimed at mapping marital adjustment dimensions among married Libyan women in Tripoli and testing associations with family structure, marriage type, spousal age gap, marriage length, and spouse-selection criteria.
